description: Run terraform plan and return a human-readable diff of what will change. Safe — makes no changes to infrastructure.

savePlanFile.description: Optional path to save the binary plan file for use with tf_apply

target.description: Limit operation to a specific resource address, e.g. aws_instance.web

vars.description: Variable overrides in key=value format, e.g. ["region=us-east-1"]

workdir.description: Absolute or relative path to the directory containing .tf files

workspace.description: Terraform workspace to use (default: current workspace)

name: tf_plan
